description: Crypto cycle position — where are we in the cycle? Default BTC: point-in-time 9-indicator aggregation (Pi-Cycle Top & Bottom, Mayer Multiple, weekly RSI, 200-week-MA distance, halving position, Fear & Greed, BTC-dominance trend, mining-difficulty trend — each indicator’s 0-100 sub-score is in the score_* fields; the weights are in drivers[] under fields="full"; indicator_coverage says which had input). Includes an `ath` block (its note states basis and reference prices). Pass asset=ETH or asset=SOL for a per-coin cycle read built from the transferable price-derived indicators (Mayer, weekly-RSI, 200-week-MA distance) with renormalized weights; BTC-native indicators (halving, dominance, mining, F&G, Pi-Cycle) are returned as `not_applicable` rather than faked. All return raw + Z-Score, signal enum, and a `percentiles` block ranking each indicator against that asset’s own history. The `signal` enum is a SCORE-BAND LABEL (accumulation · recovery · expansion · distribution · overheated, low to high), not an independent market-phase detection: the middle band is neutral, so a mid-band score reads "expansion" even in a drawdown market — the label describes the score band, not the market. signal_band gives the band limits; signal_band_basis says whether they are today’s rank-equivalent limits (rank_equivalent_today, rows since 2026-10-16) or the fixed table <25 · 25–45 · 45–60 · 60–75 · ≥75 (fixed_bands, older rows). BTC additionally returns `highlights[]` (empty array = nothing unusual) and `price_context`, each self-describing. score_fields_note in the payload explains the four score fields; halving_context carries the halving timing. Pass fields="full" (BTC) for `drivers[]` (per indicator: sub-score, weight, contribution, percentile_rank). Related: arena_get_historical_analog (what followed states like this one), arena_get_bullmarket_ampel, arena_get_pulse. [Free tier]

asset.description: Which asset’s cycle. Default BTC. ETH/SOL return a price-derived cycle read with not_applicable fields for BTC-native indicators.

fields.description: BTC only. 'full' adds `drivers[]` (indicator sub-scores with renormalized weight, contribution summing to raw_score, percentile_rank with basis and n) plus drivers_note.
